==Description==
'''Badlands''', internally referred to as '''BadlandsEnemies''', is a [[Modifiers|modifier]] that increases all currency rewards by 20%.

'''Badlands''' appears exclusively in [[Badlands II]]; it is active in all matches on that map.

==Effects==
Previously, this modifier used to affect the health of multiple enemies and replaced multiple enemies that appeared on this map with their western variants. However, as time went on, this functionality was slowly replaced by other parts of the game, until it has been replaced completely. Currently, its only purpose is playing intro jingles at the start of Waves 1, 10, 20, 30 and 40.

Prior to [[Badlands II]] being moved to the [[Challenge Maps]] system, it replaced the following enemies<ref name="challenge">These changes still persist in [[Badlands II]] due to them being tied to its challenge.</ref>:
*The [[Husk]] used to replace the [[Fallen]].
*The [[Undead Miner]] used to replace the [[Fallen Hero]].
*The [[Cavalry]] used to replace the [[Fallen Guardian]].
*The [[Gunslinger]] used to replace the [[Fallen King]].

The modifier also used to replace more enemies before the [[v1.4.2|Halloween 2022 Update]]<ref name="challenge"/>:
*The [[Breaker2]] used to replace the [[Mystery]].
**The [[Breaker2]] also spawned the [[Breaker]] upon death.
*The [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] used to replace the [[Dark Necromancer]].
**The [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] also spawned [[Skeleton]]s with its ''Summon'' ability.
*The [[Breaker4]] used to replace the [[Mystery Boss]].
**The [[Breaker4]] also spawned the [[Breaker3]] upon death.
*The [[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] used to replace the [[Templar]].
*The [[Necromancer King|Necromancer Boss]] used to replace the [[Summoner Boss]].
**The [[Necromancer King|Necromancer Boss]] also spawned [[Cursed Skeleton]]s with its ''Cursed Summon'' ability.

Prior to [[Badlands II]] being moved to the [[Challenge Maps]] system, '''Badlands''' changed the health of multiple enemies<ref name="challenge"/>:
*[[Skeleton]] health was changed to 50 ({{Color|Yes|+35}}).
*[[Warden (Legacy Enemy)|Warden]] health was changed to 10,000 ({{Color|Yes|+2,000}}).
